name: Tameeni Insurance
note: Insurance-comparison platform; badge on the upper chest of many Saudi Pro League shirts in 2026-27. Unrated — ownership not fully traceable: Tameeni is wholly owned by listed Rasan Information Technology (Tadawul: 8313), whose IPO prospectus names four individuals as 5%+ holders but also two custodian vehicles holding 13.06% and 4.49% (post-offering) on behalf of Impact46-managed venture funds (Venture Capital InsurTech Fund and Impact Growth Fund); those funds' investors are undisclosed, and Saudi state fund-of-funds SVC has publicly invested $30m in Impact46's Fund III (Saudi Press Agency, 2 October 2023), so a state-fund stake behind Rasan's largest line cannot be excluded.
